name: Dual Contouring 2D (CUDA)
definition: A CUDA implementation of Dual Contouring for 2D mesh grids, used as a final project for CS 217 at UC Riverside. It extracts isosurfaces from scalar fields by constructing Quadratic Error Functions (QEFs) at grid cell intersections.
summary: Dual Contouring 2D (CUDA) extracts 2D isosurfaces from scalar fields using CUDA parallelism with tiled blocks, atomic operations, and parallel prefix sums for vertex and edge generation.
